title: Project: Distributed Notification Fanout
summary: Build a notification fanout with per-channel rate limiting and circuit breaking, time-windowed idempotency, and at-least-once delivery that never repeats a unit it already finished.

rubric.label: Delivery guarantees
rubric.description: A retryable failure is never dropped, a finished unit is never re-sent, and the report never claims success for a fanout that left work unfinished.

rubric.label: Failure policy
rubric.description: Rate limiting, retry classification and the circuit breaker behave correctly against the injected clock: bursts above capacity are impossible, permanent errors are not retried or counted as outages, and an open circuit recovers.

rubric.label: Module boundaries
rubric.description: channels, dedupe and fanout stay separable: the leaves do not import the orchestrator and no state is shared between channels or stores.
